name: hunt-encoded-powershell
hypothesis: An attacker is using encoded PowerShell on at least one host.

name: hunt-living-off-the-land
hypothesis: A signed Windows binary is being abused to run code.

name: hunt-c2-beaconing
hypothesis: A host is beaconing to a known-bad demo domain at regular intervals.

name: hunt-persistence-registry
hypothesis: An attacker has set a Run key for persistence.

name: hunt-credential-dumping
hypothesis: LSASS memory is being accessed for credential dumping.
